---
title: "Start here"
---

Cancer Basemap is read anonymously — no account, no token. A release is a
folder of Parquet files plus `cancerbasemap.duckdb`, a DuckDB database of
views over them, served over HTTPS. Every client below speaks the same SQL
underneath; pick the one you already use.

## The one statement every client needs

```sql
ATTACH 'https://basemap.cancerdatasci.org/data/latest/cancerbasemap.duckdb' AS cbm (READ_ONLY);
USE cbm;
```

Once attached, every table is `cbm.<namespace>.<table>` — `cbm.measure.observation`,
`cbm.geography.unit`, and so on (plain `measure.observation` after `USE cbm`).
See the [Dictionary](/dictionary/index.qmd) for the full table and column
list. Each release also holds a `views.sql` that creates the same views in your
own session, and every table as a plain Parquet file (`measure/observation.parquet`)
that any engine can read.

`latest/` moves each month. For anything you will rerun, replace `latest` with
a dated folder such as `v2026-11-02`, and cite the Hugging Face tag
(`seandavis/cancerbasemap@2026-11-02`) — see
[Versions and citation](/guides/versions-and-citation.qmd). A release holds
current rows only, so there is no `valid_to` to filter on.

Python's default `urllib` user agent is blocked by the zone (HTTP 403,
Cloudflare error 1010): fetch with `duckdb`, `requests` or `polars`.

## Pick your client

- [Python](python.qmd) — the `duckdb` package, worked examples
- [DuckDB CLI](duckdb-cli.qmd) — no install beyond the `duckdb` binary itself
- [R](r.qmd)
- [SAS](sas.qmd)
- [SEER\*Stat](seerstat.qmd)

`value` is `NULL` whenever `value_status` is not `'reported'` — see
[Concepts › Suppression](/concepts/suppression.qmd) before you filter or
aggregate a measure.
